description: This file contains a service class `SubmissionService` for managing data product submission workflows, including creating submissions, retrieving submissions by ID, and updating submission states with audit logging. It interacts with a database and an audit service, and handles related pipeline jobs for validation.

classes.name: SubmissionService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing submission lifecycle events, state transitions, and audit logging in a data product submission workflow.
